rca_of_issue: Repro: create listing -> pay fee -> promote intent -> confirm promotion -> call GET /api/listings?sort=new. Result: 500. Backend stacktrace points to server.py listings_list line comparing promotion.ends_at (naive datetime from DB doc) against now_utc() (timezone-aware), raising TypeError. Mitigation: normalize both datetimes to same timezone awareness before comparison and add regression test for mixed datetime formats.
